## Checklist

- [ ] One change, as small as it can be; nothing unrelated rides along
- [ ] `npm run coverage`, `npm run check-isolation` and `npm run ui-check` pass on my machine
- [ ] What is new has a test, and coverage is still 100%
- [ ] No network code and no new packages
- [ ] The version, `package-lock.json` and `.github/` are as I found them
- [ ] The README or `docs/` say what changed, where a user or a theme author would notice
- [ ] No real names, user folders, session titles or secrets anywhere in it
- [ ] I understand every line here, including any an AI tool wrote
